title: Gpu Requirements For Harvester
definition: The need for a GPU for efficient execution of the harvester script, and the alternative options for users without GPU access.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The harvester script needs a GPU to run efficiently. If you don't have a GPU, you can use a simpler version of the script or submit your data to us for processing.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The harvester script requires a GPU for multiple LLM calls per concept. A minimum of 6GB VRAM is recommended for Mistral 7B. For Codestral enrichment, 12GB+ VRAM is recommended. For CPU-only use, a stripped-down harvester or external processing is an alternative.
difficulty_levels.expert: The harvester script's GPU requirement stems from its demand for multiple LLM calls per concept. While Mistral 7B can run on lower-end GPUs, the inclusion of Codestral in the pipeline raises the bar. This highlights the trade-off between speed and accuracy in AI applications, and the role of GPU in accelerating such processes. For CPU-only use, a stripped-down harvester can be used as a fallback, but this may compromise the quality of the output.

extra_fields.insight: The requirement for a GPU for efficient execution of the harvester script underscores the computational intensity of large language models and highlights the role of GPU in accelerating such processes.
